mapper.select: select n.id, n.title, n.content, n.author, n.create_time as createTime from t_like l left join t_news n on l.news_id = n.id where l.user_id = #{userId} order by n.create_time desc
select user_id as userId, news_id as newsId from t_like where user_id = #{userId} and news_id = #{newsId} limit 1
mapper.delete: delete from t_like where user_id = #{userId} and news_id = #{newsId}
